pages.text: Compresses aether into a visible pulse aimed at a device. This tier commonly reaches 8 blocks and carries up to 100 per pulse. An adjacent reservoir supplies its reserve.

pages.title: Make the route visible
pages.text: Use the tuner on the emitter and then the destination. Its head turns to face that point. Keep the route clear: the pulse must arrive before it fills the destination.$(br2)One emitter sends one pulse at a time, so longer journeys mean longer waits. Sneak-use the tuner to pause output.
